items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Oh yeah, I worked with Kid Ren there. He was on a pledge for a year, not drinking. So I joined him and we did real well.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well that time it was plenty of money. Yeah, it was made up with George, George Fields, he played. And I came, I got sick, I came back home and I got back here, these fellas around here were making more money than they made in Chicago. Going up and down, right after the war then, you see. Going up and down the road to Hammond, Ponchatoula. And I joined up with Amos Riley, was in charge of the band. It was the Tulane band. And Frankie Dusen was playing in the band at the time.
